question: Two punt-return miscues doomed San Francisco in its 20-17 overtime loss to the Giants in the January 2012 NFC Championship Game. Which 49ers returner made both of them?
explanation: Williams was returning punts in place of the injured Ted Ginn Jr. A ball that brushed his knee set up a fourth-quarter Giants touchdown, and his overtime fumble set up the game-winning field goal.

question: In his final game, John Elway threw an 80-yard touchdown pass in Denver's 34-19 win over Atlanta in Super Bowl 33. Who caught it?
explanation: Smith, who had entered the NFL as an undrafted free agent, broke the game open in the second quarter. Shannon Sharpe hurt his knee on Denver's opening touchdown drive and left the game early.

question: Mark Ingram won the 2009 Heisman Trophy by just 28 points, the closest vote in the award's history at the time. Who finished second?
explanation: Stanford's Gerhart totaled 1,276 points to Ingram's 1,304. Colt McCoy, Ndamukong Suh and Tim Tebow rounded out the top five.

question: Baltimore's Duane Starks took an interception 49 yards to the end zone in Super Bowl 35, and New York answered at once by running the ensuing kickoff back 97 yards for a score. Which Giant went the distance?
explanation: Baltimore's Jermaine Lewis took the very next kickoff back 84 yards, completing three touchdowns on three straight plays in 36 seconds.

question: Steve Young threw a record six touchdown passes as San Francisco beat San Diego 49-26 in Super Bowl 29. Jerry Rice scored three touchdowns. Which 49er also scored three?
explanation: Watters and Rice became the first Super Bowl teammates to each score three touchdowns. Watters' scores included a 51-yard catch-and-run in the first quarter.

question: Early in Texas A&M's 29-24 upset at No. 1 Alabama in November 2012, Johnny Manziel bobbled the ball, caught it in midair and threw a touchdown pass on the run. Who caught it?
explanation: The 10-yard score to Swope made it 14-0 in the first quarter. Malcome Kennedy later caught the touchdown that put the Aggies up 29-17.

question: Michigan lost 42-39 at Ohio State in the No. 1 vs. No. 2 showdown of November 2006. Which Wolverine ran for three touchdowns that day?
explanation: Hart carried 23 times for 142 yards, his first 100-yard game against Ohio State. Troy Smith countered with four touchdown passes for the Buckeyes.

question: Colorado beat Missouri 33-31 in October 1990 on a touchdown scored on an erroneously granted fifth down. Which quarterback scored it?
explanation: Johnson was in for the injured starter Darian Hagan and ran it in from the 1 as time expired. Bill McCartney's Buffaloes went on to share the 1990 national title.

question: Texas A&M knocked Kansas State out of the national title race with a 36-33 double-overtime win in the 1998 Big 12 Championship Game. Who caught Branndon Stewart's winning 32-yard touchdown pass on third-and-17?
explanation: Parker, a running back playing on a sore hamstring, made the catch. Stewart was starting only because Randy McCown had broken his collarbone the week before against Texas.

question: Late in the Giants' 15-13 win at San Francisco in the January 1991 NFC Championship Game, Roger Craig fumbled with the 49ers protecting a 13-12 lead. Which Giant forced the fumble?
explanation: Nose tackle Howard fought through a double team and jarred the ball loose, and Lawrence Taylor recovered. Earlier, Leonard Marshall's hit had knocked Joe Montana out of the game.
